title: ITS_LIVE ice velocity datacube, N60W140 (polar stereographic)
description:
ITS_LIVE (NASA MEaSUREs) image-pair ice velocity datacube for tile N60W140, Zarr V2, consolidated. `v` (velocity magnitude) is [mid_date, y, x], shape [16314, 834, 833], chunks [16315, 10, 10] -- the time chunk (16315) covers the entire mid_date axis (16314 image pairs) in a single chunk, confirmed from the store's own `.zarray`. Grid is EPSG:3413 (NSIDC Sea Ice Polar Stereographic North), with the CRS carried as `crs_wkt` on a non-dimension coordinate variable named `mapping` (not `spatial_ref`). bbox is estimated from the store's `geo_polygon` attribute (northern Yukon/Alaska border area).

License not stated in the store's own metadata; declared "proprietary" with a via link to the ITS_LIVE project.

Expected browser outcome: refused by the chunk-amplification guard (~16000x: one tile needs one time step, the chunk holds all 16314).
